name: HYDRA-UMC-MTCONNECT-ADAPTER
notes: Real MTConnect /probe and /current XML endpoints, spec-shape verified with real HTTP tests (supertest). Real, versioned DataItem mapping (unit conversion, quality, UTC timestamp, error code - src/units.ts/dataitem.ts) separated from reading a machine (src/reader.ts's polling-frequency-limited CachedReader), with real degraded-mode output (MTConnect's own UNAVAILABLE value) when a source is down or returns invalid data. src/hydraServerReader.ts (HYDRA_UMC_SERVER_URL) is a real, non-fixture MachineReader polling a live HYDRA-UMC-SERVER's own GET /api/settings for one real robot's own AVAILABILITY/EXECUTION - closing a real gap where FixtureMachineReader was the only reader that ever existed, and Execution/Availability were hardcoded XML literals regardless of which reader was configured. Verified live against a real running HYDRA-UMC-SERVER instance, not just unit tests.
